_README: The shared connection-type vocabulary — the stud sizes. Two organ ports connect iff their `type` matches. Curated deliberately: a new type is added only when no existing one fits (sprawl defeats the standard). Each type pins the shape that flows on that wire. See CONNECTORS.md.
_VENDORED: This is a vendored snapshot of orchestrator/types.json @ feat/drift-gate, copied into this organ repo so the conformance Action can validate ports.json against the vocabulary offline. The two entries marked `_proposed` are NOT yet in the upstream vocabulary — they are proposed by this organ's connection-ports retrofit PR and need review/merge into orchestrator/types.json (feat/drift-gate) before the composer can rely on them. Re-sync this file from upstream once the proposals land.

TenantContext.desc: A resolved tenant: identity, branding, provenance bag.

SiteCrawl.desc: Signals crawled from a prospect's website at signup.

InterviewTranscript.desc: Ordered Q&A pairs from a discovery interview.

KeyFacts.desc: Themed facts extracted from a transcript (the discovery memory).

EntityGraph.desc: Deduplicated canonical entities (people, systems, tools) per tenant.

Blueprint.desc: The system blueprint: modules + integrations + current/recommended state.

ProcessFlow.desc: Sequence / swimlane of a workflow extracted from transcript themes.

AccountState.desc: A fleet account's pacing/quota state (the pace + drift gates' input).

ClaimVerdict.desc: Whether a worker may claim work now, and why (gate output).

BillingState.desc: A tenant's subscription / billing state + feature entitlements.

ConformanceVerdict.desc: Whether an organ/output conforms + groundedness (self_metric shape).

ProvenancedArtefact.desc: Any spec/feature the scan-and-select takes from the OLD apparatus, wrapped with its origin + succession status so the new machine knows it as inherited, never native. Retain history, know it as such — succession baked in, the antidote to old-artefacts-polluting-new. See FRESH_APPARATUS.md.

SalesPipeline.desc: Sales-pipeline deal rows (the CRM-lite state): per-tenant stage, deal value, and time of last stage change — the source data an always-fed sales source adapter scans.
SalesPipeline.schema: array<{tenant_id:int, tenant_slug:str, display_name:str, pipeline_state:{stage:str, stage_changed_at:str, deal_value_estimate_usd:number, deal_value_currency:str}}>
SalesPipeline._proposed: Proposed by organ-ae-adapters-sales-adapter connection-ports retrofit. No existing vocabulary type covered CRM sales-pipeline state (PendingItems is downstream work items, BillingState is subscription state, TenantContext is a single resolved tenant). Needs review/merge into orchestrator/types.json (feat/drift-gate).

FeedCandidates.desc: Always-fed work-item candidate directives produced by the AE source adapters (github / sales / feedback): each a ready-to-spawn directive carrying a dedup correlation_id and persona target, awaiting queue admission. The shared OUTPUT stud of the source-adapter family.
FeedCandidates._proposed: Proposed by organ-ae-adapters-sales-adapter connection-ports retrofit. The standard always-fed candidate contract; no existing type matched its shape (PendingItems is {items:[{id,atoms}]} — a different downstream shape consumed by the prioritiser). Reusable across the whole source-adapter family, so it is a deliberate shared stud, not sprawl. Needs review/merge into orchestrator/types.json (feat/drift-gate).
